scope: Finite v24 design and actual isolated API feasibility probe; not production transport, native fixture preparation, candidate freeze or authorization.

design_checks.new_identity_and_budget_boundary: New execution/resources/binaries/nonce; c13 failed prep and budgets retained. No same-binary gate bypass or generic old-source fallback.
design_checks.retained_partial: Only exact c13 inspector remains disabled/no-policy/no-groups, unused by new workers, with no secret copy or mutation. Other identities remain strict sole-policy;15 known identities and five never-created c13 names are distinguished.
design_checks.zip_import: Only fixed localhost PUT/import-iam-v2 with empty query; one exact regular Store member and one exact current user -> version1/sole policy; bounded compressed/decompressed bytes, no secrets/status/other IAM material, duplicate/path/field expansion rejected.
design_checks.mutation_identity: Validated user/policy participates in replay key; per-user once, UNKNOWN never resent.
design_checks.response: Strict raw skipped/removed/added/failed schema; no skipped/removed/failed entities; exactly one Added.UserPolicies mapping and no other added entities; post-read disabled/no-groups/sole policy plus official policy Equals.
design_checks.boundaries: Source/Restore/current preflight/root share the exact retained partial rule; enable paths select only new current identities. No Core/Port/queue/schema change.
design_checks.acceptance_order: Production guarded success/counterexamples and same-image guarded SDK contract precede Source; exact committed HEAD CI, cold resource/ownership gates and separate native result review remain required.

actual_probe_checks.journal_pairs: Seven unique UUID starts and observations, matched and ordered; all transport_error=false.
actual_probe_checks.old_apis: AttachPolicy and SetPolicy each returned404; typed SDK error checks report XMinioAdminNoSuchUser.
actual_probe_checks.raw_import_response: Exactly skipped={}, removed={}, added.UserPolicies=[{dpp307-contract-disabled:[dpp307-contract-readonly]}], failed={}; no duplicate JSON keys.
actual_probe_checks.sdk_raw_distinction: SDK reserialization adds null policy/user fields; production validation must use preserved raw response rather than mistake SDK-normalized output for raw bytes.

actual_scratch_inspect.both: Stopped/PID0/noports/no-restart, exact images; Native owns only the intended new volume; worker exit0/UID10001/readonly/capdropALL/no-new-privileges/three exact mount destinations/no socket.

limitations.independent_binary_hash: NOT_PERFORMED; probe binary SHA is recorded by intent/worker receipt, source matches intent.
